test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The population of a village was 1,10,000. It increased by 5% in the first year and increased by 30% in the second year. Its population after two years is _____ .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Initial Population** = 1,10,000

**First Year** Increase = 5% → Multiplying factor = 105/100 = 21/20

**Second Year** Increase = 30% → Multiplying factor = 130/100 = 13/10

**Final Population** = 1,10,000 × (21/20) × (13/10) = 550 × 21 × 13 = 1,50,150

**∴ The correct answer is 1,50,150.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Initial Population (P)** = 1,10,000

**Rate 1 (R₁)** = 5%

**Rate 2 (R₂)** = 30%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4668ead287a2529b429552c656f04f59c4bf720657018d6ecb66d479922d1a88.png] 

**Formula Used:** Final Population = P × (1 + R₁/100) × (1 + R₂/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 × 1.05 = 1,15,500

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,15,500 × (1 + 30/100)

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,15,500 × 1.3

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,50,150

**∴ The correct answer is 1,50,150.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes by x% and then y% successively, the net percentage change is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Population Depreciation

If the population decreases by R% annually, the population after n years is P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ.

Effective Rate Method

In this case, net increase = 5 + 30 + (5 × 30)/100 = 35 + 1.5 = 36.5%. Final = 1.365 × 1,10,000 = 1,50,150.</p
